author: Ben

changes: Initial release with comprehensive data validation
RFC 5322 email validation with domain and TLD checks
Batch email validation for multiple addresses
URL validation with protocol, host, port, path parsing
Credit card validation with Luhn algorithm
Credit card type detection (Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Discover, etc.)
JSON schema validation with type, required, minLength, maxLength, pattern, enum, format support
Nested JSON object and array validation
Regex pattern matching with groups and locations

description: Comprehensive data validation module written in Go and compiled to WebAssembly. Features email, URL, phone number, IBAN, credit card (Luhn algorithm), international postal code, JSON schema, and regex pattern validation. Supports multi-country formats and auto-detection. Optimized for GoWM integration.

errorHandling.description: Validation module returns structured objects with valid:true/false and detailed error messages
errorHandling.detection: if (typeof result === 'string' && result.startsWith('Error:')) { /* arg error */ } else if (!result.valid) { /* validation failed */ }

examples.error: Error: one argument required for validateEmail (email string)
{ valid: false, error: 'IBAN check digits validation failed (MOD-97)' }

examples.cause: Luhn check failed on credit card
examples.error: { valid: false, luhnValid: false, error: 'Luhn check failed: invalid card number' }

errorHandling.pattern: object-based with valid boolean and error string
